title: 50bb · Flop · Queen-high diamonds
description: A saved flop-to-river game on Qd Td 7d at 50bb starting depth, with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. Broad weighted ranges put made flushes, sets, two pair, overpairs, diamond blockers, and straight draws in the same game. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
rangeAssumptions: Illustrative per-combination inclusion multipliers: BTN AA x1, KK x0.75, AQo x0.75, AQs x1, KJs x0.75, 98s x0.5; BB QQ x1, TT x1, 77 x1, QTs x0.75, KQo x0.5, AJs x0.75, J9s x0.75, Q7s x0.5. Weights describe range inclusion, not action frequencies. Board blockers are removed before normalization; private cards are drawn jointly with exact card removal. Priors are declared assumptions, not certified preflop frequencies. All later betting and ordered card arrivals belong to one conditional flop-to-river game, not a full-hand solution or a universal 50bb model. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
